learning_outcomes.text: They gain sufficient background in mathematics, science and basic engineering. They learn the solution methods of equations that cannot be solved analytically.
Identifies engineering problems, identifies problems that arise during application, develops appropriate analytical methods and approaches for this purpose, selects and applies modeling methods
Gains the ability to design a system, process, device or product under realistic constraints and conditions to meet certain requirements and to apply modern methods for this purpose
They can express and use the data obtained from experiments in engineering applications with the most appropriate functions.

Gain the ability to scan resources, collect data, design experiments, conduct experiments, calculate derivatives of the results, analyze, interpret and transfer them to practice for the solution of engineering application problems.

To solve engineering application problems, students acquire the skills to scan resources, collect data, design and conduct experiments, calculate integrals of the results, interpret them, and transfer them to practice. They can also calculate integrals that cannot be calculated analytically numerically.
By understanding the concept and types of errors, they can calculate errors in various engineering processes.

syllabus_topics: Errors; Concept of error, Relative and absolute errors, Truncation errors.
Error calculations; Taylor and Maclauren series.
Solutions of nonlinear equations, Simple Iteration and Bisection methods
solution of nonlinear equations Newton-Raphson and Tangent method.
Finite differences, Divided differences interpolation, Linear interpolation
Least squares method. Curve fitting problems.
Numerical differentiation; Numerical differentiation by curve fitting.
bibliography: R. Khoury, D.W. Harder, Mühendislikte sayısal yöntemler ve modelleme, Springer 2016
